lines.x: South Korea's KOSPI index halted trading after plunging 8% amid steep losses in artificial intelligence-related equities.
Asian equity markets slumped sharply, with South Korea's Kospi triggering a circuit breaker after the Nasdaq lost $2.5 trillion, while Taiwan entered a bear market and the Nikkei fell 6%.
South Korea's KOSPI plunged 12% amid a midterm blue wave political shift and an intensive technology sector sell-off, according to Goldman Sachs.
Asian chipmakers and data center equipment suppliers across South Korea, Taiwan, and Japan faced sharp declines following the technology sector sell-off in US markets.
